questions.question: Why does a reviewer screen favour Design B?
options: Weak results still carry the suggestion and its evidence.
questions.explanation: With Design A a weak case returns None and the evidence is lost. Design B keeps it on every result.

questions.question: What is the main difference between a tracer bullet and a prototype?
options: A prototype runs end to end; a tracer bullet does not.
A tracer bullet is kept and grown; a prototype is thrown away.
questions.explanation: Tracer-bullet code is the real skeleton of the system. A prototype answers one question and is discarded.

questions.question: What should you write first when comparing two interfaces?
options: The calling code each design would need
questions.explanation: The caller's code shows the cost of an interface directly. Implementations can wait until you have chosen.
